changes: Added four measured CC0 rigid-part families: Figurine 148, Ghost 413, Fish 422 and Penguin 558.
Upgraded the existing 72-triangle Blocky family to expose six rigid body pieces, 27 source clips and shape presets.
Added manifest-driven FORMA/PARTES controls. Presets toggle named nodes without family-specific runtime branches.
Added explicit appearance_transfer contract for offline cross-family baking and validation.
Kept direct texture swaps restricted to validated shared-UV families.
